Debrief DB-021
1) Actor premeditated a staged injury scheme.
2) A written exhibit recording the plan was left behind.
3) No ethical review of the fraudulent intent was conducted.
4) Coworker and doctor were coerced into participation.
5) Insurance fraud safeguards were bypassed without detection.
